figures.alt: Continuous black ridge vent beneath cap shingles on a finished residential roof
figures.caption: A ridge vent has to work with the roof geometry and the available soffit intake. Check the whole ventilation system before cutting a ridge slot.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: White perforated soffit providing attic intake beneath a Florida roof eave
figures.caption: The high exhaust path only works when outside air can enter low at the eaves. Confirm that the soffit construction and existing baffles can keep this intake open.

figures.alt: Attic insulation held clear of a roof-edge airflow route
figures.caption: Verify intake airflow from the attic side and keep insulation from closing the eave path. Exhaust without intake can worsen pressure and moisture problems rather than solve them.
